payload.author: codex
payload.body: Crate 0.4 migration audit: Crate has app-level RBAC helpers in src/api/authz.ts for owner/staff/viewer checks and audit logging around sensitive commands. Today those checks live inside custom app routes rather than Frick policyHooks, but the generic need is the same: product-owned authorization should tighten framework/object/route writes without forking the Rust server. Please consider Crate as an acceptance case alongside Zavro: tenant membership role lookup, command/action names, and audit event emission need a documented way to run near authz decisions.
